what_it_probes: A large usage-billing system whose golden invoices fail; Finance blames renderer rounding, but there are 16 independent upstream bugs, no narrating comments, each contradicting a rule stated only in docs/. Eight are visible in goldens (DST period end, volume up_to exclusive, proration over the segment's calendar month, coupons after tax, FX memo keyed on one currency's quote date, naive CSV split, JSON-lines ISO offset dropped, late fee re-billed). Three are cross-module chains whose symptom is 2-3 modules from the cause: a timestamp-parse memo keyed on the wall clock without the offset (ingestion -> segment assignment -> wrong plan's pricing), allocation weights truncated to integers in money.allocate (-> per-line tax with discount spread), and proration rounded to cents in plan currency before FX conversion (-> yen line off by 1). Five are revealed by no visible test, only by indirect tickets (invoice numbers, finance phrasing) plus docs: credit usable on its expiry day, billing address taking precedence over service region, replay dedup per feed file, same-day plan changes ordered by plan id, no final invoice for closed customers. Two masking pairs (C01 DST+CSV; C10 CSV+dedup) cancel exactly. Stage 2: rebill API/CLI from docs/REBILL.md against stored buggy issued invoices. Stage 3: a 3-cycle restatement (docs/RESTATEMENT.md) carrying overcharges forward as expiring account credits under the normal credit rules, correcting unpaid receivables and re-running dunning/late fees on them, and emitting a byte-exact summary, a double-entry journal with reversals and fixed account order, and a daily revenue schedule (ratable base, point-in-time usage, largest-remainder residues to earliest days). Hidden tests: direct API per cause, all goldens, prior-cycle invoices, rebill and restatement reports on the visible and an unseen October 2026 dataset. Stage 4: a month-end close package from docs/CLOSE.md (~700 reference lines): three legal entities by invoice currency, intercompany service charges by resolved tax jurisdiction, FX revaluation of open receivables after payment allocation with next-day reversals, translation to USD with posting-level rounding and a 7200 balancing line, intercompany eliminations, and a byte-exact audit pack (entities, revaluation, journal, trial balance, tie-out) whose tie-out must hold; every upstream bug except the late-fee one changes stage-3/4 outputs.
